items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: Ondo to launch tokenized Anthropic stock on IPO day
headlines.summary: Ondo’s ANTon token will track Anthropic shares from the day the Claude maker starts trading on Nasdaq.

headlines.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks
headlines.summary: Christopher Waller says stubborn inflation may warrant a bigger December rate hike, while a separate speech outlined why blockchain-based payments still need traditional settlement systems and stronger safeguards to scale.

headlines.title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
headlines.summary: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

headlines.summary: Visa plans to let eligible Visa Direct clients in Asia-Pacific fund cross-border payouts with stablecoins.

headlines.title: Backpack Secures NFA Approval Ahead of US Perps Launch
headlines.summary: The futures intermediary approval follows CFTC exchange and clearinghouse orders. American customers still face a waitlist, not an open trading venue.

headlines.title: How Tokenized Nvidia Traded Through Two Weeks of Huang Headlines
headlines.summary: Seven tokens give their holders a claim on the same Nvidia share. On Sunday 8 November, with every US exchange shut, that share was priced 6.3% apart depending on which token a holder owned.

headlines.summary: The exchange says its shorter name reflects an existing business in perpetual futures and tokenized stocks, rather than a new token or product launch.

headlines.summary: The exploration of AI agents with JPMorgan builds on Hyundai’s recent stablecoin-based cross-border remittance pilot.

headlines.summary: SYRUP is about 27% below The Defiant’s Nov. 10 reading. Maple’s dashboard now lists an October buyback smaller than September’s.

headlines.summary: In today's newsletter, Ark Invest buys crypto stocks while selling $85 million in Nvidia; Coinbase expands onchain crypto loans to New York via Morpho; and more.

headlines.summary: The initiative plans to initially focus on an intermediated and interoperable stablecoin-based payment model.

headlines.summary: Eligible institutions can mint and redeem USDC through DBS, the companies say, adding a bank-based route for dollar-stablecoin liquidity.

headlines.summary: ETHFI is down about 32% over four weeks, while the protocol's staking TVL has fallen about 11% in the past week.

headlines.summary: World Liberty Financial's stablecoin reached its lowest daily supply reading in a 30-day window, with declines across Solana, Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain.

headlines.summary: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.

headlines.summary: Circle's USDC infrastructure and Citi's banking connections will underpin an exploration of stablecoin-based development-fund payments, not a live rollout.

headlines.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
headlines.summary: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

headlines.summary: Coinbase has expanded its onchain crypto loan product to New York residents, with BTC, ETH and SOL as the supported collateral.

headlines.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

headlines.summary: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

headlines.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted repeatedly trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid using confidential Robinhood listing plans, pocketing $125,523.

headlines.summary: The platform handles fiat conversion and stablecoin swaps for payment firms, with Dragonfly citing $25 billion in annualized volume.

headlines.summary: Sir Nicholas Lyons told Solana's Breakpoint that tokenization should benefit ordinary investors, not just wholesale institutions.

headlines.summary: Monad announced 10 xStocks markets on Nov. 12. Trading liquidity is live, but access restrictions and collateral-pricing requirements still matter for DeFi builders.

headlines.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
headlines.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.
